```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load data
df <- read_csv("results.csv")

# Clean algorithm column: strip surrounding single quotes
df <- df %>%
  mutate(algorithm = str_remove_all(algorithm, "'"))

df <- df %>% rename(n = `graph_size (n)`)



# Summarize: mean + standard error for shading
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(algorithm, graph_size = n, density) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_time = mean(solve_time),
    sd_time = sd(solve_time),
    se_time = sd_time / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = graph_size, y = mean_time, color = as.factor(density))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ algorithm, scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(
    title = "Solve Time vs Graph Size Separated by Graph Density",
    x = "Graph Size (n)",
    y = "Solve Time",
    color = "Density",
    fill = "Density"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )

```
**Average solve time for graph sizes**

```{r}
# Compute average solve time over the 5 trials
avg_df <- df %>%
  group_by(algorithm, graph_size = n, density) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_time = mean(solve_time),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# If you want ONE line per algorithm (averaging across densities too):
avg_df2 <- avg_df %>%
  group_by(algorithm, graph_size) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_time = mean(mean_time),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot
p <- ggplot(avg_df2, aes(x = graph_size, y = mean_time, color = algorithm)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Average Solve Time vs Graph Size",
    x = "Number of Nodes (n)",
    y = "Solve Time (ms)",
    color = "Algorithm"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(
    "./plots/solve_time_graph_size.png",
    plot = p,
    width = 10,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 600
  )
  
print(p)
```





```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Average over the 5 trials
summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(graph_size = n, density, algorithm) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_time = mean(solve_time),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot with free y-axis per facet
l <- ggplot(summary_df,
            aes(x = density,
                y = mean_time,
                color = algorithm)) +
  
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ graph_size, scales = "free_y") +
  
  # Force consistent x-axis labels
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.0),
    labels = c("0.1", "0.3", "0.5", "0.7", "0.9", "1")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Average Solve Time vs Density Across Different Graph Sizes",
    x = "Graph Density",
    y = "Solve Time (ms)",
    color = "Algorithm"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()

# Save plot
ggsave(
  "./plots/solve_time_density.png",
  plot = l,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)

# Print plot
print(l)
```




```{r}
# Summarize: mean + sd per algorithm, density, and graph size
density_summary_df <- df %>%
  group_by(n, density, algorithm) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_solve = mean(solve_time),
    sd_solve   = sd(solve_time),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

# Plot: Solve Time vs Density, faceted by graph size
p_density <- ggplot(density_summary_df, aes(x = density, color = algorithm, fill = algorithm)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_solve - sd_solve,
                  ymax = mean_solve + sd_solve),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_solve), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_solve), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ n, labeller = label_both, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", labels = algo_labels) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1",  labels = algo_labels) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(density_summary_df$density)) +
  labs(
    title = "Solve Time by Graph Density",
    x     = "Density",
    y     = "Solve Time (s)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

print(p_density)
```
